
而 `Mov edi，[esi+0ch]` 是取 `IRP+0ch` 位置处

`kd> dd 887a4458+0Ch`

```
887a4464  00000000 8879ed38 8879ed38 00000000 -----<<<<<<这里是 0
887a4474  00000000 01010001 0c000000 0013fedc ------Mov edi，[esi+0ch]，此时 edi=0 了
887a4484  00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 -----Mov edx,[edi] ，读 0 地址，引发 BSoD
887a4494  00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000
887a44a4  00000000 8879eb28 00000000 00000000
887a44b4  00000000 887a44c8 89af9318 00000000
887a44c4  00000000 0005000e 00000000 00000000
887a44d4  000b204c 00000000 89bbfec0 89af9318
```
